message.content:
A mandoline slicer is a kitchen utensil. Mandolines with blades typically classify under 8210.00.00 (hand-operated mechanical appliances weighing 10 kg or less used for food preparation), or under 8214 or 3924. A display unit made wholly of plastic and lacking blades would not function as a mechanical appliance, so it is classified by its material as plastic kitchenware under 3924.90.56 (other household articles of plastics). In CBP rulings, display units of mandolines without blades were classified in 3924.10.40 (other kitchenware of plastics). The heading 3924 subheading 3924.10 covers tableware and kitchenware, and 3924.10.40 is "Other" (other than tableware or kitchen utensils such as those in 3924.10.20 for cups/saucers, etc.). Since the unit is a display kitchen item, 3924.10.40.00 is the best choice, and the 10-digit statistical code is 3924.10.4000.

{"hts_code": "3924.10.4000", "reason": "A bladeless, all-plastic display mandoline cannot function as a mechanical food-preparation appliance of heading 8210, so it is classified as plastic kitchenware in heading 3924."}
